Error in coefficient: 0.16666 vs 1/6=0.1666667, diff 6.7e-6, times reduced^6 ≈ (0.347)^6 ≈ 0.0017 → error ~1.1e-8*scale... times scale up to 2^14 (x=10, exponent=14) → ~1.9e-4 relative?
